label: Investigated organizational function as a biological due standard
summary:
Investigated a candidate interpretation of biological due capacities in docs/notes/goodness-form-end-definitions.md. Consulted Mossio, Saborido and Moreno on differentiated organizational function, regimes, compensation and usefulness; Cummins on organized causal capacities; Neander's positive explanation of selected-effect standards in present mechanisms; Bird on evolved powers; and Barandiaran on graded malfunction. Primary Chlamydomonas studies discriminate nutritional support, photosynthetic competence and regulated inactivity. An explicit analyst recurrence fixes one assigned bearer, material renewal, environmental inputs and reserve challenges. Python calculations distinguish normal role, partial and uncompensated failure, compensated failure, external help, healthy inactivity and incidental emission; normal native capacity preserves a two-state shock invariant while compensation alone does not. These are finite numerical checks, not Lean certification or empirical validation. Reused the existing arrangement, turnover and thin unity boundaries rather than inventing a duplicate independence result. Compared organizational, selected-effect, causal-role and hylomorphic explanations; current organization is not Papineau etiological selection. Provisional support is for a scoped biological good-for candidate: the independent due-actuality thesis, class/environment applicability, powers interpretation, substantial unity and practical authority remain additional. No source claim, theorem, result registration or root-premise discharge is added. Continuation 2026-11-25 in the same note, From material function to source finality: preserves the earlier recurrence and biological evidence, distinguishes local contribution from Best for the same bearer, and tests stable-attractor, selected-history, malfunction, novelty and conflicting-organization interpretations. Reuses primary organizational and selected-effect accounts, with the reproductive extension retaining its causal/temporal organization conditions. Identifies a specific transfer failure: the retained underived source does not depend on its contingent recipients for self-maintenance. The stronger rival can instead supply recipient forms and their own goods through an intrinsic generative nature; actual source production for that good and apprehended governance remain further relations. No new model, theorem, pinned claim or moral-authority bridge.

#2103 coverage audit at 632e76a81. (c) The proposed one-bearer reserve/competence comparisons from #1646 and #1962 now compile in OrganizationalMaintenance.trajectories, nativeDemand, shocks, normalHistory and boundAndSignal. No dedicated result or argument record attaches these computations to 6cc47d1b (DueActualityThesis, definitions 2b760306 and 68191121). They evaluate a stipulated input-driven recurrence and preserve the finite native-function invariant; compensated or externally supported persistence and incidental output have different profiles. (e) The proposed inferential step from organized competence to due actuality still needs the fixed bearer, environment, due role and relevant independent reason for that role. Next test compares viable endogenous reorganization, compensated failure and reversible inactivity under the same challenge. The recurrence neither transfers due status to every actuality nor entails original direction by an underived producer.
blocker: The mechanism fixes rather than independently warrants the organism class, developmental stage, environmental challenges and continuing bearer. The next discriminating test compares supported defect, reversible downregulation and equally robust endogenous reorganization within that same scope, measuring challenged competence as well as present maintenance. If history retains a role whose present maintenance contribution has disappeared, organizational and selected-effect standards may diverge. A faithful formal slice would reuse arrangement histories for the explicit recurrence and invariant; no fresh Lean certification was available in this environment. Individual maintenance does not by itself establish reproductive ends, an irreducible soul, the general due-actuality thesis or categorical authority. Source-level extension: local role-relative good does not establish optimum for the same x, actual production for that good by n, or the absence of intellectual direction. The underived producer needs a distinct account of its generative orientation; current organizational maintenance does not ground that orientation by making the producer dependent on recipients. Continue only with evidence addressing these scoped application requirements or the earlier concrete class/competence discriminator.

current_assessment.scope: Material function, objective biological good-for and transfer to ultimate-source finality in PR-1962; retains the PR-1646 due-capacity mechanism and applicability limits.
current_assessment.assessment: Differentiated organization and selected history supply positive noncognitive accounts of proper function under stated bearer, class, history and environmental conditions. They can distinguish failure, compensation and inactivity; persistence alone cannot. Role-relative contributions neither automatically yield Best for that bearer nor settle conflicts between different bearers or categorical moral authority. The retained underived, necessary and invariant source is not maintained by its contingent recipients, so organism-level maintenance does not itself explain the source’s orientation toward their goods. A distinct intrinsic generative-nature proposal remains a serious impersonal account of giving recipients their forms; apprehending and actually acting for those goods remains a substantive further personal relation. Neither ultimate application is established here. The maintenance-transfer conclusion uses underivedness and the specified productive relation, not necessity alone.
current_assessment.next_test: Keep bearer, completion and conditions fixed when comparing a due capacity, compensated defect and successful substitute. For the ultimate extension, give a positive constitution of n’s recipient-directed generative power or actual practical measure; do not infer it from a beneficial output or make n an organism that survives through its recipients. Reopen local standards when justified history, endogenous reorganization or bearer/lineage evidence separates organizational and selected-effect attribution.
